maps.name: Drop-Off
maps.description: An industrial rooftop arena with control rooms, elevated platforms and working ziplines.
maps.notes: Adds 366 source placements: conduits, clamps, tanks, crates, furniture and structural details. Uses 97.06% of native world index capacity with no added dynamic entities. Preserves minimap, Northstar banners, displays, paint, lighting, safety volumes and ziplines. Some scenery and animated materials remain incomplete. Intro and evac are disabled.

maps.name: Phase Runner
maps.description: Snow, rock and industrial tunnels connect opposing bases beneath the phase machinery.
maps.notes: Adds 432 source scenery placements: supported ground plants, flowers, small snow rocks and power equipment. Uses 97.04% of native world index capacity with no added dynamic entities. Preserves minimap, displays, paint, lighting, team modes and catwalks. AI navigation and some layered/animated materials remain incomplete.

maps.name: Overflow
maps.description: An industrial arena with elevated lanes, molten channels and opposing bases.
maps.notes: Initial geometry, collision, source materials, direct lightmaps and player probes. Native pilot-mode, spawn, angle and reload checks use one local client. Some scenery, foliage, materials and distant backgrounds remain incomplete. Lower authored LODs and resident textures reduce detail. No Apex interactions, AI navigation, Titan modes, intro or evac. The three new previews together have not been tested; enable one at a time. A longer shared Overflow/Party Crasher session crashed during repeated mode changes; restart between new previews. The cause is unresolved.
